spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bent, bowed, reclining.
2 Crooked, curved.
n. (-तं)
1 The are or distance of any planet from the zenith.
3 A plant or its root: see तगर and तगरमूल.
E.
नम to bow or bend, affix क्त.

f. (-का)
Any hour of birth, after noon or before midnight.
E.
नत, and नाडिका a period of twenty-four minutes.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Flat-nosed.
E.
नत bowed, and नासिक the nose.

m. (-गः)
(In Astronomy,) Zenith distance.
E.
नत, and भाग a part.

mfn. (-भ्रूः-भ्रूः-भ्रू)
Frowning.
E.
नत, and भ्रू the brow.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Down-faced, looking down.
E.
नत, and मुख the face.

mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध)
Looking down, hanging down the head.
E.
नत, मूर्द्धन् the forehead.

m. (-शं)
Zenith distance, (in Astronomy.)
E.
नत, and अंश a degree.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Bent, curved, bowed, stooping.
f. (-ङ्गी)
A woman.
E.
नत, and अङ्ग the body.

f. (-तिः)
1 Bending, bowing, stooping.
2 Curvature, crookedness.
E.
नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
1 Praise, eulogium.
2 Surprise, wonder.
m. (-त्रः)
Ś

A sage.
E.
नम to bow, ष्ट्रण् affix, म is dropped, and the short radical vowel made long.
